method: Read-only retrieval of SEC submissions, primary Forms 8-K/424B4 and issuer earnings exhibits. No new price provider or production mutation. Sanitized evidence excludes raw market prices and bars.

diagnosticNameMismatch.interpretation: NewBirdAI must not be treated as the current legal registrant name or proof of a new security. SEC proves legal continuity, not provider metadata correctness.

nextSteps: Reconcile Tiingo and exchange-directory names to the effective June 15 legal change using a dated, sourced issuer-name alias record.
Retain existing company/issuer/security/listing IDs and historical Allbirds name; verify Class A listing continuity rather than minting a new issuer based on a branding label.
Reassess fundamental/factor semantics after disposal of the footwear business without rewriting historic PIT filings.

securities.interpretation: The July 31 after-close earnings/guidance event is credible context for the following session move. It is separate from the July 11 reverse-split session. SEC filings do not independently certify the size or correctness of the August 1 Tiingo return.

The IPO and February 25 earnings events are verified. Listing approval/prospectus date and IPO completion date are different observations; these filings alone do not establish first traded bar or provider availability date. Offering transaction values must never become a prior daily market bar. Neither event independently verifies large returns in the Tiingo series.

Confirm the bars on both sides belong to the same listing/share class; do not splice an old issuer, offering transaction, stale alias or distinct share class into traded daily history.
Recheck the same Tiingo sessions and metadata through its existing endpoints; retain response hashes and run IDs without adding a price provider.
